title.zh: 宣布每年 3 月 10 日为阿布拉省特别非工作假日（名称为阿布拉日）的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring March Ten of Every Year as a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Abra to Be Known as Abra Day
title.orig: An Act Declaring March Ten of Every Year as a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Abra to Be Known as Abra Day

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7281_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: March Ten of every year is hereby declared as a special nonworking holiday in the Province of Abra to commemorate the creation of the Province, to be known as Abra Day.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
